never_waived: reviewed code/tests and exact scoped task before any native execution
allowed_future_outputs: Artifact schemas,read/join chronology,counts,order-outcome receipts and explicitly scoped synthetic trade/fee subledger conservation. All outputs carry both labels and a review/generation link.
forbidden_conclusions: zero dividend,zero split or no-event assumption from missing rows
missing_event_fields: Unknown cash/quantity/dividend-tax adjustments remain null with reasons, never quietly zero. Retain positions; stale marks are valuation-only and missing prior marks yield NAV_UNRESOLVED.
existing_originals: Never add labels by rewriting source files; label only new test artifacts/metadata.
closure: A process/fixture pass can close only the specific mechanics check, never CA coverage,unit evidence or overall usability.
